Description: Iron Seal proprietary clause strictly prohibited copying, distribution, or commercial deployment without individual written authorization
Evidence: LICENSE file previously specified 'Iron Seal Proprietary and Exclusive License' to Divyanshu Kumar
Impact: Blocked open-source developer adoption, package redistribution, and commercial evaluation
Reproduction Instructions: Inspect LICENSE file at repository root
Recommended Fix: Adopt standard dual-licensing (MIT for core UI primitives + Commercial for enterprise builders)
Acceptance Criteria: Developer-friendly MIT license applied to core package with clear commercial demarcation

Description: Client-side mock authentication creates dangerous security assumption if confused with backend auth
Evidence: AuthContext stores mock tokens in browser localStorage without server session signing
Impact: Risk of developers building production apps with unprotected backend APIs
Reproduction Instructions: Inspect useAuth and AuthGuard; check network tab for absence of server validation
Recommended Fix: Add prominent application security warnings in docs; provide abstract AuthAdapter contract for external identity providers
Acceptance Criteria: Documentation and source files explicitly declare mock nature; AuthAdapter interface provided

Description: Monolithic bundle packaging without fine-grained subpath exports for tree-shaking
Evidence: dist/index.js is 233.37 kB and dist/index.umd.cjs is 154.29 kB containing all 40+ components and parsers
Impact: Consuming apps import full library bundle even if only using Button and Heading
Reproduction Instructions: Inspect package.json exports field and dist/ bundle contents
Recommended Fix: Configure package.json subpath exports (`@criation/ui/button`) and declare sideEffects: false
Acceptance Criteria: Single component import (`import { Button } from '@criation/ui/button'`) results in < 10 kB bundle size

Description: Select component placeholder option previously rendered invalid HTML `selected` attribute
Evidence: React console warning: 'Use the `defaultValue` or `value` props on <select> instead of setting `selected` on <option>'
Impact: HTML validation warning and potential hydration mismatch
Recommended Fix: Ensure placeholder option uses `disabled value=''` without `selected` prop
Acceptance Criteria: Zero React console warnings when rendering Select with placeholder

Description: Input and TextArea components did not render visible error text container when error was a string
Evidence: Components accepted error prop but only styled red borders without displaying the error message string
Impact: Users could not see why form input validation failed
Recommended Fix: Add dedicated `<div className='criation-input__error-msg'>` rendered when error prop is a non-empty string
Required Tests: Input and TextArea error message rendering tests
Acceptance Criteria: Error string is visibly rendered beneath input with aria-live='polite' and aria-describedby linkage

Description: Tabs component was missing `aria-controls` attribute linking tab headers to tab panels
Evidence: Screen readers could not programmatically associate active tab button with content panel
Impact: WCAG 2.2 Section 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value accessibility non-conformance
Reproduction Instructions: Run automated axe-core scan on rendered Tabs component
Recommended Fix: Add `id` to tab panels and `aria-controls` to corresponding tab trigger buttons
Acceptance Criteria: Tab button has `aria-controls='panel-{id}'` matching panel element id

Description: Popover trigger wrapper lacked keyboard accessibility attributes
Evidence: Non-button triggers could not be activated via Enter or Space key navigation
Impact: Keyboard-only users cannot open or close popover triggers
Reproduction Instructions: Attempt to focus and toggle Popover trigger using keyboard only
Recommended Fix: Add `role='button'`, `tabIndex={0}`, and `onKeyDown` handler to Popover trigger element
Required Tests: Popover trigger role and tabIndex test
Acceptance Criteria: Popover trigger element has role='button' and tabIndex=0

Description: Fluent method chaining was tightly coupled to native React component instances
Evidence: React components contained builder chaining methods on class prototypes causing typing friction
Impact: Confused TypeScript developers expecting standard React functional components
Reproduction Instructions: Attempt to pass standard React JSX props to chainable instances
Recommended Fix: Decouple fluent builder into dedicated `ui` namespace with explicit `.build()` method returning standard ReactElements

Description: Test suite runs inside lightweight Node.js VM rather than official testing frameworks (Vitest, Playwright)
Evidence: scripts/test-suite.js manually validates stringified HTML and object outputs
Impact: Cannot test real browser layout rendering, touch physics, focus sentinels, or hydration
Recommended Fix: Introduce Playwright cross-browser component testing matrix with Chromium, Firefox, WebKit
Acceptance Criteria: Automated execution of Playwright test templates across supported browser runtimes

Description: Missing automated axe-core accessibility test suite in CI pipeline
Evidence: Accessibility verified manually or through static attribute assertions
Impact: Risk of regressions violating WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards
Recommended Fix: Add automated axe-core WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility test integration
Acceptance Criteria: Automated CI step validates zero critical or serious WCAG accessibility violations

Description: Drawer component lacks touch swipe-to-dismiss gesture support on mobile devices
Evidence: Drawer is opened and closed solely via CSS state class without touch coordinate tracking
Impact: Sub-optimal user experience on mobile and touch devices
Reproduction Instructions: Swipe downward on mobile drawer panel; observe no movement
Recommended Fix: Add touch start, move, and end event listeners with physics-based sliding threshold
Acceptance Criteria: Drawer dismisses smoothly when swiped past threshold on touch-enabled devices

Description: Absence of CLI code generator for rapid project scaffolding
Evidence: Developers must manually install Vite, React, TypeScript, configure paths, and import CSS
Impact: Slow developer onboarding and potential configuration mistakes
Reproduction Instructions: Run `npx @criation/cli create` in terminal (command not found)
Recommended Fix: Create `@criation/cli` package supporting template generation and component add commands
Acceptance Criteria: `npx @criation/cli init` creates fully configured working application in under 30 seconds

Description: Declarative Table lacks row virtualization for datasets exceeding 1,000 items
Evidence: All rows rendered directly to DOM simultaneously without windowing
Impact: Sluggish performance and frame drops on large corporate datasets
Reproduction Instructions: Pass array of 5,000 objects to `<Table data={...} />`
Recommended Fix: Add virtual scrolling engine and windowed pagination for large datasets
Acceptance Criteria: Table maintains 60 FPS scrolling and responsive rendering with 10,000 rows

Description: Natural language DSL parser throws generic errors on unparseable tokens
Evidence: Lexer splits on whitespace and matches regex rules; unmatched tokens produce generic fallback
Impact: Beginner developers encounter opaque errors when typing typos in DSL strings
Recommended Fix: Enhance parser with AST generator providing line, column, and suggested keyword fixes
Acceptance Criteria: Parser returns actionable error highlighting the exact invalid token and suggestions
